{{Quote|Unidentified ship, this is Shieldship Nine. Ready to lock; please transmit your slave circuit code.''"<br />"''Right, [&hellip;] Shieldship Nine, we don't have a slave circuit. Just give me your course and we'll stay with you.|The shieldship pilot and Captain Han Solo|<ref name="Heir" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''pilot''' [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] [[Shieldship Nine]], one of [[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] [[shieldship]]s, located at the<ref name="Heir" /> [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nkllon/Legends|Nkllon]],<ref name="Heir" /> in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> When [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] arrived at [[Nkllon/Legends|Nkllon]] seeking to speak with Calrissian at [[Nomad City]], a [[City/Legends|city]] located at Nkllon, the pilot hailed them, informing Solo that as his [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], did not possess a [[Slave circuit]]&mdash;which would allow the pilot to control the ship&mdash;he would need to wait ten [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] to arrive at the city. As Nkllon's [[Star/Legends|sunlight]] would [[Fire/Legends|burn]] his starship's [[Hull/Legends|hull]] if it was unprotected&mdash;not covered by the shieldship's shadow&mdash;Solo agreed to wait. Shortly after a [[AA-589/Legends|ship]] appeared at Nkllon, the pilot informed Solo that both of them would enter at the same time. As Solo was informed by his companion, [[Prince/Legends|princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], that the ship was [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[X-wing starfighter]], Solo agreed to entering with Skywalker. Following the ten hour wait, the pilot cleared Solo and Skywalker for landing at Nomad City.<ref name="Heir" />

==Behind the scenes==
The pilot first appeared in ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'', the first volume in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy]]''.<ref name="Heir" />
